import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    N = len(s)
    solve = []
    i = 0
    while i < N:
        if i + 3 <= N and s[i:i+3] == "dot":
            solve.append(".")
            i += 3
        elif i + 2 <= N and s[i:i+2] == "at":
            solve.append("@")
            i += 2
        else:
            solve.append(s[i])
            i += 1
    solve = ''.join(solve)
    # Check()
    if solve and solve[0] == '.':
        solve = "dot" + solve[1:]
    elif solve and solve[0] == '@':
        solve = "at" + solve[1:]
    if solve and solve[-1] == '.':
        solve = solve[:-1] + "dot"
    elif solve and solve[-1] == '@':
        solve = solve[:-1] + "at"
    cnt = solve.count('@')
    if cnt == 1:
        sys.stdout.write(solve + '\n')
    else:
        out = []
        ok = True
        for ch in solve:
            if ch == '@':
                if ok:
                    out.append('@')
                    ok = False
                else:
                    out.append("at")
            else:
                out.append(ch)
        sys.stdout.write(''.join(out) + '\n')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
